statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Every passive OPEN call either creates a new connection record in LISTEN state, or it returns an error; it MUST NOT affect any previously created connection record (MUST-41).
actions: create new connection record in LISTEN state or return error
do not affect any previously created connection record

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: A TCP implementation that supports multiple concurrent connections MUST provide an OPEN call that will functionally allow an application to LISTEN on a port while a connection block with the same local port is in SYN-SENT or SYN-RECEIVED state (MUST-42).
statements.trigger: OPEN call to LISTEN on port
actions: allow application to LISTEN on port while existing connection block with same local port is in SYN-SENT or SYN-RECEIVED state

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: The optional "local IP address" parameter MUST be supported to allow the specification of the local IP address (MUST-43).

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: If an application on a multihomed host does not specify the local IP address when actively opening a TCP connection, then the TCP implementation MUST ask the IP layer to select a local IP address before sending the (first) SYN (MUST-44).
statements.trigger: active OPEN without local IP address on multihomed host
actions: ask IP layer to select a local IP address before sending the first SYN

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: At all other times, a previous segment has either been sent or received on this connection, and TCP implementations MUST use the same local address that was used in those previous segments (MUST-45).
statements.trigger: segment send or receive on connection with prior segment history
actions: use the same local address that was used in previous segments on this connection

statements.subject: tcp
statements.description: A TCP implementation MUST reject as an error a local OPEN call for an invalid remote IP address (e.g., a broadcast or multicast address) (MUST-46).
statements.trigger: OPEN call with invalid remote IP address
actions: reject OPEN call as an error
